d:
You know what I wish I knew a while back...

Translating something that doesn't feature word balloons is an effing nightmare.

This here is a collection of short stories from the mind of Sekki kettle and I (fool that I am) thought it would be fun translating this behemoth (spoilers: it was not).

But were finally here, only ONE more in this series to go, and you'll finally have em all. Sorry to make you wait this long

Crab out, Peace.
n: [Doujinshi] [Sekki Kettle Jidai (Sekki Kettle)] Sennou Sareta Oukoku | Brainwashed Kingdom
